name: Wakamiya Asuka
source:
Wakamiya Asuka is [url=/c500]Shuuji’s[/url] childhood friend. They live together in the Mikaze house along with Rika-nee, and also in the same class. Cheerful and carefree, Asuka is best friends with [url=/c504]Nanami[/url] and close to [url=/c495]Ruriko[/url]. Both Asuka and [url=/c499]Rika-nee[/url] couldn’t cook, so they used to eat raw food before Shuuji came back to the island.

[Edited from [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2010/02/11/asukimi-wakamiya-asuka/]Rin's character review[/url].]
